In [[990 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]'' leading up to [[Darovit]]'s [[Death/Legends|death]] [[990 BBY|ten years after]] the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]], which occurred in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], according to [[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> the pollen from a '''flower''' was scattered by the hermit [[Darovit]] around the construction site of a monument under construction in the [[Valley of the Jedi]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]], to honor the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]]. The pollen was pungent, and it attracted tens of thousands of small [[Bird/Legends|birds]] to the site, enough to make further work on the monument impossible for three [[Standard day/Legends|days]].<ref name="ROT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Plant/Legends|flower]] appeared in the [[2007]] novel ''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]'', written by [[Drew Karpyshyn]] as the second installment in the ''[[Star Wars: Darth Bane Trilogy]]'' series of novels.<ref name="ROT" />
